claim: What mouse settings do you guys use? : r/VALORANT - Reddit
summary: A good metric people use to compare sensitivies is eDPI. eDPI is just your mouse DPI multiplied by your in-game sens. So for you, with mouse DPI of 800 and in-game sens of 1.8, your eDPI is 3240. The average pro player plays on about 280 eDPI, with outliers such as hiko playing at around 500-600 eDPI.
